summary: We developed an educational training tool for young people, created with the help of artificial intelligence. The game will teach children facts about space, and we used Gemini as the AI. Our game has two modes: Hard Mode and Easy Mode
details:
We developed an interactive educational game and training tool designed for children, built with the power of artificial intelligence (Gemini). Through collaborative brainstorming, we focused on creativity and problem-solving, bringing the project to life using computer programming and code.

This project not only teaches children fascinating facts about space but also introduces them to the fundamentals of project design. To cater to different learning paces, the game features two distinct difficulty modes: Easy Mode and Hard Mode.
